settings.description: Review effective application settings. Changes require an exact preview and fresh authentication.
settings.viewer: You can inspect these settings. An administrator is required to change them, export configuration or clean up history.
settings.gatesNote: Deployment flags are read-only here. Each infrastructure action still needs its own target, capability, permission and confirmation checks.
settings.audit.exceeded: The audit row quota is exceeded. Follow the operator audit lifecycle; general cleanup does not remove audit records.
settings.audit.note: The operator controls this protected policy. General cleanup never includes audit records.
settings.export.note: Generate an audited JSON file containing only approved non-secret settings. Every provider host, target and logical credential reference is masked. The file cannot restore credentials.
settings.export.confirm: Generate the masked configuration file for this installation.
settings.export.generated: The masked configuration file was generated and passed to the browser download.
settings.cleanup.note: Choose retention-eligible history. The server freezes the allowed cutoffs and counts for review. Users, sessions, sources, current settings and audit records are excluded.
settings.cleanup.remaining: More eligible rows remain. Review a new preview before another bounded batch.
settings.cleanup.complete: No further eligible rows were reported for the approved cutoffs.
settings.dialog.description: Review this exact action, confirm its effect, then enter your current password. A submitted confirmation cannot be reused.
settings.dialog.batch: Each cleanup batch removes at most {count} rows.
settings.dialog.continuous: This shorter retention policy continues to expire eligible history over later bounded runs. The batch limit is not a limit on the total history that may be removed.
settings.dialog.backup: History removal cannot be undone here. Verify a usable backup before proceeding.
settings.dialog.backupConfirm: I have reviewed the backup and data-loss impact.
settings.dialog.confirm: Apply only the exact changes and scope shown above.
settings.error.invalid: Use valid whole numbers and complete the required confirmations.
settings.error.session: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again before starting a new review.
settings.error.denied: This action was denied. Check your role and current password before starting a new review.
settings.error.stale: The policy changed. Reload it and review a new preview.
settings.error.confirmation: The preview expired or was already used. Reload and review a new preview.
settings.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait before starting a new review.
settings.error.unavailable: The settings service is unavailable. Reload before starting a new review.
settings.error.uncertain: The result is unknown. Reload settings and inspect audit history before deciding whether another action is needed. Do not repeat this confirmation.
